records.title: Lifelong Language Pretraining with Distribution-Specialized Experts
records.reason: The paper concerns lifelong language pretraining and distribution-specialized experts; its method is a training/data adaptation approach rather than inference optimization.

records.title: The Illusion of Certainty: Decoupling Capability and Calibration in On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: This work studies calibration in on-policy distillation and scaling effects; it does not describe a serving or inference-cost reduction.

records.title: Bringing Value Models Back: Generative Critics for Value Modeling in LLM Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Generative critics address value modeling/credit assignment for LLM reinforcement learning; this is training-time method development, not inference efficiency.
